episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the evolving landscape of luxury real estate, driven by AI wealth and lifestyle optimization. She emphasizes the importance of building strong relationships and leveraging AI and social media to enhance personal branding. The episode also provides practical tips for navigating multiple offers and standing out in a competitive market.
